name: Checkin Scheduler
script:
# Scheduler Event # Frequency: Daily (run after shift end, e.g., at 22:00 or set as "Daily") today_date = frappe.utils.today() today_dt = frappe.utils.getdate(today_date) # Fetch all check-in records for today that have IN but no checkout missing_checkout_records = frappe.db.get_all( "Employee Checkin", filters={ "log_type": "IN", "log_type_out": ["in", ["", None]], "checkout_time": ["in", ["", None]], "time": ["between", [ str(today_dt) + " 00:00:00", str(today_dt) + " 23:59:59" ]], "skip_auto_attendance": 0 }, fields=["name", "employee", "employee_name", "time", "shift", "shift_end"] ) if missing_checkout_records: # ── Build HTML table for email ── rows = "" for rec in missing_checkout_records: rows += "{0}{1}{2}{3}".format( rec.employee, rec.employee_name or "", rec.time, rec.shift or "N/A" ) email_body = """

The following employees checked in today but have not checked out:

{0}
Employee ID Employee Name Check-in Time Shift

Please review and take necessary action.

""".format(rows) # ── Fetch HR Manager emails ── hr_emails = frappe.db.get_all( "User", filters={"enabled": 1}, fields=["email", "name"] ) hr_role_users = frappe.db.get_all( "Has Role", filters={"role": ["in", ["HR Manager", "HR User"]], "parenttype": "User"}, fields=["parent"] ) hr_user_names = [u.parent for u in hr_role_users] hr_email_list = [u.email for u in hr_emails if u.name in hr_user_names and u.email] if hr_email_list: frappe.sendmail( recipients=hr_email_list, subject="Missing Checkout Alert - {0}".format(today_date), message=email_body ) # ── Also log each as a Frappe Log for traceability ── for rec in missing_checkout_records: frappe.log_error( title="Missing Checkout: {0}".format(rec.employee_name or rec.employee), message="Employee {0} ({1}) checked in at {2} on {3} but has not checked out.".format( rec.employee_name, rec.employee, rec.time, today_date ) )
